author: G4_FO76
body: The Elysian class-line is widely debated as the strongest pre t10 class, however once reaching t10, majority of the other class-lines eventually catch up (especially with celestial classes) and outperform it. While the Elysian class-line is still viable for regular t10 gameplay, the other classes available are just more efficient than Elysian besides running endless. The Elysian class is most notable for completing deep reliable endless runs and is the preferred choice when doing so.

author: Warfnair
body:
Summoner seems like some kind of a fix to long and bumpy road towards endgame that happens just before finish line, T9. For T9 class it can deal insane amounts of dmg (especially when you have Buggane) with little to no gear. Survivability is also way better because summons protect you very often. Same goes for early T10 - you don't need any hard farm for gear to be able to do significant progress in T10 which is not the case for all the other classes.

The way I see it it is done this way to keep players interested in game enough to get through T9 and farm gear for desired end-game class using summoner once they hit T10.

author: skratch
body: I play thief typically but at T9 got a quest to finish a raid in a single attempt with no deaths. Couldn’t do it as a nyx with good gear, but could do it with summoner with mid gear hardly upgraded at all. It works, but it’s slow and boring. So I kept the summoner setup to switch to when I needed to finish a tougher raid or a tower titans. Finally around lvl 232 or 233 I got the gear/setup I needed to solo raids as a realmshifter and haven’t bothered w summoner since.
